title: PDL / PDH Liquidity Sweeps (Turtle Soup)
summary: Resolution rates when price sweeps the prior session low (PDL) or high (PDH) and reclaims back inside the prior range (ICT Turtle Soup). High-probability reversal signal when aligned with morning liquidity grabs and 10:00 AM macro releases.
deltas: Evaluates false breaks of previous day low (PDL) and high (PDH)
Identifies whether morning liquidity sweeps resolve into green closes
Cross-condition with Candle Science C1->C2 sequences and Initial Balance breaks
